mapper.insert: insert into departmentpayroll(onedepartment, twodepartment, threedepartment, number, dtime, register, checked) value(#{onedepartment}, #{twodepartment}, #{threedepartment}, #{number}, CURDATE(), #{register}, 0)

insert into employeepayroll(dpid, ename, sid, checked) values
(#{employeePayroll.dpid}, #{employeePayroll.ename}, #{employeePayroll.sid}, 0)
mapper.update: update departmentpayroll set departmentsalary = ( select SUM(salarystd.total) from employeepayroll join salarystd on salarystd.sid = employeepayroll.sid where employeepayroll.dpid = #{dpid}) where dpid = #{dpid}
